description: Type the 409 `no_running_turn` a steer gets when the conversation has nothing in flight. The spec documents it on POST /sandboxes/{sandboxId}/steer ("Refused with **409 `no_running_turn`** when the conversation has nothing in flight; queue work with `POST /prompt` instead"); it generated as a bare Conflict. `error.details.reason` says why and stays in the body. Source: spec-mirror-boat-dev 71ab00f.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The conversation has no turn in flight to steer. Queue the message with `promptSandbox` instead.
